startUrl.title: Start URL
startUrl.description: LinkedIn jobs search URL to scrape. Paste the full URL from your browser.

maxJobs.title: Max Jobs
maxJobs.description: Maximum number of job listings to scrape.

maxPagesPerQuery.title: Max Pages
maxPagesPerQuery.description: Maximum number of result pages to paginate through (each page has ~25 jobs).

delayBetweenJobsMs.title: Delay Between Jobs (ms)
delayBetweenJobsMs.description: Milliseconds to wait after clicking a job card, before extracting. Increase if details aren't loading.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify Proxy settings. Residential proxies recommended for LinkedIn.
